Narrative Summary
In August 2026, WPD handled 264 calls for service. Excluding Security Checks, Whittier accounted for 79 and
Girdwood 64 calls. Serious incidents stood out, including Theft/Burglary (5), Alarm (5), MVA/Accident (4),
Suicidal / Mental Health (3). Additionally, there were 2 death-related call this month. Jurisdictional mix: Whittier
51.0%, Girdwood 46.0%, Other 0.8%.

Bullet-Point Summary
•   Whittier: 135 calls. Top types: Parking Problem (18), Traffic (14), Animal (6).
•   Girdwood: 121 calls. Top types: Traffic (20), Disturbance (9), Alarm (5).
•   Other: 2 calls. Top types: Reddi (1), MVA/Accident (1).
